_note: t34 unit U1a (agent/t34_attention.py). Risk orientation of every feature it writes: +1 = higher value is RISKIER (more likely C->W), -1 = higher value is safer. Declared before any evaluation row was scored; residualising or ranking an un-oriented score is the t33 pitfall this file exists to prevent.

_sources.lr_*: 2407.07071 section 5: heads with positive classifier coefficients mean 'more context attention = more factual', so a HIGHER lookback ratio is SAFER. The paper keeps both signs per head; these scalars are the head-pooled summary and take the paper's majority direction.
_sources.attn_sink_*: 2404.15574 section 4.1: during hallucinated generation the retrieval heads predominantly attend to the initial token of the input, the attention sink.
_sources.attn_cos_prev_step / attn_drop_maxdoc: 2510.14973 section 3.3: a low cross-step cosine is the drift alarm; losing the previous step's top document is evidence loss.
_sources.attn_gist_ratio / lr_gist_vs_raw_mean: no paper counterpart (compression-specific); declared hypothesis - leaning on the compressed slot rather than the raw tail is riskier.
_sources.S8 block: digest section 4.5 control block; more compression and more dropped blocks are riskier, more surviving tokens are safer.
_sources.cap block: 128-token cap confound (digest section 1.3): a longer, cap-censored generation is riskier.
_sources.attn_gist_frac: ONE column only (the duplicate attn_history_gist_frac was deleted: it was the same number by construction with an independently declared orientation). Orientation -1. Its DENOMINATOR is the TOTAL attention mass over all five key classes, so it is the context-vs-self axis of 2407.07071 (its complement is attn_generated_so_far_frac, +1): more mass on the retrieved history slot = less self-attention to what the model has already written = safer, the same direction as every lr_* column. This does NOT contradict attn_gist_ratio / attn_rh_gist_ratio (+1), whose denominator is gist + raw tail only: that is a WITHIN-history choice (leaning on the compressed slot rather than the raw tail is riskier), not a context-vs-self quantity, and it is undefined for every row of the pure c2kv recipe, which has no raw tail. On the full arm (S0 twin) the history_gist CLASS holds raw KV, so attn_gist_frac is a history-SLOT fraction there and its cross-arm delta is a slot-occupancy comparison, not a like-for-like one.
